name: task_status
description: Show status of all asynchronously spawned tasks: full task_id, agent, model, current state (ready/running/waiting/sleeping/stopped/terminated/completed/failed/timeout/cancelled), and each task's latest live progress/checkpoint snapshot, without blocking. Finished tasks' output is included inline and collected immediately, so you can use the result and integrate its full task_id without calling task_wait or task_audit.
